import re, sys
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date

SRC = sys.argv[1]
YEAR = 2026
MONTHS = {m: i for i, m in enumerate(
    ["jan","feb","mar","apr","may","jun","jul","aug","sep","oct","nov","dec"], 1)}

DATE_PATTERNS = [
    (re.compile(r"\b(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b"), lambda m: (int(m[1]), int(m[2]), int(m[3]))),
    (re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})/(\d{2})\b"), lambda m: (2000 + int(m[3]), int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})\b"), lambda m: (YEAR, int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (re.compile(r"\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b"), lambda m: (YEAR, int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (re.compile(r"\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b", re.I),
     lambda m: (YEAR, MONTHS[m[1][:3].lower()], int(m[2]))),
]
AMOUNT = re.compile(r"(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})\s*\)?\s*$")

def parse(line):
    s = line.strip()
    am = AMOUNT.search(s)
    if not am:
        return None
    amt = float(am[3]) * (-1 if (am[1] or am[2]) else 1)
    rest = s[:am.start()]
    for pat, fn in DATE_PATTERNS:
        dm = pat.search(rest)
        if dm:
            d = date(*fn(dm))
            desc = rest[:dm.start()] + " " + rest[dm.end():]
            desc = re.sub(r"[()|:,\-]+", " ", desc)
            desc = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", desc).strip()
            return d, desc, amt
    return None

CATEGORIES = [
    ("Dining & coffee", ["Local Coffee Co", "Chipotle", "McDonald's", "Rustic Tap Brewery",
                         "Panera Bread", "Starbucks", "Sushi Kame", "Thai Orchid",
                         "Bagel Corner", "Luigi's Pizza"]),
    ("Shopping", ["Amazon Prime"]),  # placeholder, overridden below
]
RULES = [  # order matters: more specific first
    ("Subscriptions", ["Amazon Prime", "iCloud", "Netflix", "Spotify Premium", "Planet Fitness App"]),
    ("Dining & coffee", ["Local Coffee Co", "Chipotle", "McDonald's", "Rustic Tap Brewery",
                         "Panera Bread", "Starbucks", "Sushi Kame", "Thai Orchid",
                         "Bagel Corner", "Luigi's Pizza"]),
    ("Shopping", ["Amazon", "Best Buy", "Target", "REI", "Barnes & Noble", "Old Navy",
                  "Home Depot", "IKEA"]),
    ("Groceries", ["Trader Joe's", "Aldi", "Kroger", "Costco", "Whole Foods"]),
    ("Gas", ["Shell", "Chevron", "BP Gas"]),
    ("Transport & parking", ["City Parking Authority", "Lyft", "Uber", "Jiffy Lube"]),
    ("Phone & internet", ["Xfinity", "Verizon"]),
    ("Health & fitness", ["Planet Fitness", "Riverside Physical Therapy", "Walgreens",
                          "CVS", "Dental"]),
    ("Entertainment", ["AMC", "Bowl-O-Rama", "Ticketmaster", "Spotify Concert", "Steam"]),
    ("Travel", ["Delta", "Marriott", "Hertz", "Airport Parking"]),
    ("UNCATEGORIZED", ["Zelle", "ATM", "PayPal", "Venmo"]),
]

def categorize(desc):
    for cat, keys in RULES:
        if any(k.lower() in desc.lower() for k in keys):
            return cat
    return None

txns, unparsed, uncategorizable = [], [], []
for n, line in enumerate(open(SRC, encoding="utf-8"), 1):
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    p = parse(line)
    if not p:
        unparsed.append((n, line.rstrip()))
        continue
    d, desc, amt = p
    cat = categorize(desc)
    if cat is None:
        uncategorizable.append((n, line.rstrip()))
        continue
    txns.append(dict(line=n, date=d, desc=desc, amt=amt, cat=cat))

print("== Lines not parsed ==")
for n, l in unparsed: print(f"  L{n}: {l}")
print("== Parsed but no category rule matched ==")
for n, l in uncategorizable: print(f"  L{n}: {l}")
print(f"Parsed transactions: {len(txns)}")

print("\n== All parsed rows (for audit) ==")
for t in txns:
    print(f"  L{t['line']:>3} {t['date']} {t['desc']:<32} {t['amt']:>8.2f}  {t['cat']}")

# --- duplicates ---
print("\n== Exact duplicates (same date, merchant, amount) ==")
